subject: Final acceptance gating: MAP lock, signatures & Day 1 alignment
messages:
From: Mike Horner <mike@elara.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@elara.com <procurement@elara.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP check-in / signers and start date

Rishi —

Great progress on the eval this week. Before we lock final dates, procurement asked me to confirm: who will be the primary signers on Redwood's side, and do you have an updated SOW and SOC2 evidence we can share with legal? Our preferred start date is Oct 20, but we need to ensure signatures + PO are aligned.

Can we get a clear go/no-go cadence so my exec and procurement can block the right approvals?

Thanks,
Mike Horner
VP Product, Elara Solutions
--
Mike Horner
Elara Solutions
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mike Horner <mike@elara.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP check-in / signers and start date

Mike —

Thanks and congrats to the team for completing the evaluation phase. Proposed closure plan (brief):

1) Map lock & redlines: we attach a MAP tracker with outstanding items and owners — please confirm names for the two Elara signers (product lead + procurement).
2) Legal & SOW: Kimberly will circulate an updated SOW (SOW_v3) if legal has no material redlines.
3) E-sign: once SOW is agreed we will issue DocuSign to both Elara signers and our authorized sigs (myself and Aditya for commercial/finance).
4) Start date: target Oct 20, contingent on executed SOW or an executed Letter of Intent + PO.

I attached the MAP_tracker.xlsx with the outstanding checklist and owners. If we can aim for legal signoff by EOD Oct 14, we can route DocuSign on Oct 15 and have signatures back by Oct 17-18 which keeps the Oct 20 start feasible.

If procurement at Elara needs a temporary bridge (provisional provisioning) we can propose a limited-capacity token until PO arrives.

I'll loop Kimberly and Camila for specifics.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_tracker.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Mike Horner <mike@elara.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP check-in / signers and start date

Thanks Rishi — quick note from legal. We reviewed the prior SOW and made one limited edit to the data retention paragraph (clause 5) to reflect 30-day ephemeral cache retention for evaluation-only usage. No commercial changes.

Mike — I attached SOW_v3.pdf with the redline. If that looks good to you I can approve to send to your procurement. For PO timing: if procurement can issue a PO by Oct 16 we’re comfortable going straight to production on Oct 20; otherwise we will enable provisional access with throttled capacity pending PO.

Please advise who will sign on Elara's side (name + title) so I can populate the signing order in DocuSign.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_v3.pdf
From: procurement@elara.com <procurement@elara.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Horner <mike@elara.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP check-in / signers and start date

Kimberly / Rishi —

Procurement here. Quick update: our internal PO window looks like it will slip to Oct 16 (we have one additional budgetary approval). That said, we can accept an executed SOW + a placeholder invoice to begin provisioning discussions. Could you also provide SOC2 documentation (or the SOC2 evidence bundle) to speed legal due diligence?

If Redwood can support provisional access with a capped throughput plan until PO is complete, procurement will mark this as approved to proceed operationally.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Elara Solutions

Attachment: SOC2_Evidence_Request.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: procurement@elara.com <procurement@elara.com>, Mike Horner <mike@elara.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP check-in / signers and start date

Team —

Appreciate the update. Actions and final commitments: 

• SOW: Kimberly's SOW_v3 is acceptable to Redwood; Kimberly please proceed to populate signing order.
• Signers: Mike, can you confirm primary signer and backup (name + title)? We'll include Aditya Rao (SVP Finance) and myself as our authorized signers in DocuSign.
• SOC2: attached is a SOC2 evidence bundle summary (SOC2_Response.pdf) for legal review.
• Provisioning: Redwood will enable a provisional, throttled capacity token for Elara effective Oct 17 contingent on an executed SOW or mutual LOI; full capacity will be provisioned upon receipt of signed SOW and PO.
• DocuSign & timeline: DocuSign has been sent to primary signers. Link: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?s=ABCDEF123456
• Target start date: Oct 20 — subject to executed SOW or LOI + PO within the agreed window. If signatures complete earlier we will accelerate provisioning.

Please confirm signers and PO ETA so we can lock the MAP and close the loop.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Response.pdf
